intent: A single- or multi-line text field with leading/trailing slots, an inline label or dropdown, a hint line, and validation variants.
use_when: A field paired with an inline unit label or a unit Dropdown.

slots.inlineLabel: inline unit / label inside the field
slots.hint: helper / validation text below the field

tokens.note: Binds to DS tokens; shares Input.tsx with ColorInput, whose color-prop default is a hardcoded #ff24bd placeholder, so this is not claimed tokensOnly.

a11y.label: the label prop is associated with the field; the hint is described-by.
